## Requirements

<a id="BreathsToSay"></a>

### Breaths to say a cue

`BreathsToSay` · `src/practice.ts:172` · status: **held**

How many whole breaths it takes to say a text, the longest of its languages, at the rate voices speak: at least one, so that a pose is held at least as long as what to do in it takes to say.

<details><summary>The rule, in the code</summary>

```typescript
({ spoken, counts }) => (texts: readonly string[], pattern: BreathPattern): number => {
    const breath = pattern.inhale + pattern.holdTop + pattern.exhale + pattern.holdBottom
    return Math.max(counts.one, ...texts.map((t) => Math.ceil(spoken(t, false) / breath)))
  }
```

</details>

- Owner: ghalaax
- Parameters: `spoken` ← [How long words take to say](content.md#Spoken) · `counts` ← [Counts](../.trame/std/docs/algebra.md#Counts)
- Refines: [The breath sets the pace](product.md#BreathSetsThePace)

<a id="Eased"></a>

### A movement goes as a breath goes

`Eased` · `src/practice.ts:77` · status: **held**

How far a movement has gone, for how far its phase has: slowly at the start, faster in the middle, slowly at the end (a cubic, the same on both halves), never back.

<details><summary>The rule, in the code</summary>

```typescript
({ easing, counts }) => (progress: number): number => {
    const { half, power } = easing
    const t = Math.min(counts.one, Math.max(counts.zero, progress))
    return t < half ? Math.pow(t / half, power) * half : counts.one - Math.pow((counts.one - t) / half, power) * half
  }
```

</details>

- Owner: ghalaax
- Parameters: `easing` ← [How a movement eases](#BreathEasing) · `counts` ← [Counts](../.trame/std/docs/algebra.md#Counts)
- Refines: [The breath sets the pace](product.md#BreathSetsThePace)
- Used by: [The moment of a practice](#MomentOf)

<a id="HoldPhases"></a>

### A hold of whole breaths

`HoldPhases` · `src/practice.ts:130` · status: **held**

The phases of the breath a pose is held for, after the movement that reaches it: from the phase after the movement's, breath after breath, as many whole breaths as asked, then on until the breath comes to the phase the next movement moves on, so that the lungs go on as they were; each phase with its length (those of no length left out) and the breath it belongs to, from the first. No breath, no hold.

<details><summary>The rule, in the code</summary>

```typescript
({ counts }) => (pattern: BreathPattern, after: BreathPhase, breaths: number, next?: BreathPhase): { phase: BreathPhase; duration: number; breath: number }[] => {
    if (breaths <= counts.zero) return []
    const order = Object.values(BreathPhase)
    const phases = counts.count(order)
    const held: { phase: BreathPhase; duration: number; breath: number }[] = []
    for (let taken: number = counts.zero, k = order.indexOf(after); ; taken = counts.next(taken)) {
      k = counts.next(k) % phases
      const phase = order.at(k) ?? after
      if (taken >= breaths * phases && (next === undefined || phase === next)) break
      held.push({ phase, duration: pattern[phase], breath: Math.min(breaths, counts.next(Math.floor(taken / phases))) })
    }
    return held.filter((h) => h.duration > counts.zero)
  }
```

</details>

- Owner: ghalaax
- Parameters: `counts` ← [Counts](../.trame/std/docs/algebra.md#Counts)
- Refines: [The breath sets the pace](product.md#BreathSetsThePace)
- Used by: [A practice](#PracticeOf)
- Applies: [The breath is the clock](principles.md#BreathIsTheClock)
- Verified by: [Holding the poses](scenarios.md#HoldThePoses)

### How full the lungs are

`LungsFull` · `src/practice.ts:104` · status: **held**

During a phase of the breath, from empty (0) to full (1): they fill on an inhale, stay full when holding at the top, empty on an exhale, stay empty when holding at the bottom.

<a id="MomentAt"></a>

### Where a practice is

`MomentAt` · `src/practice.ts:32` · status: **held**

At a time since the start, the step under way and how far it has gone, from 0 to 1: the steps follow each other, each as long as it lasts; a step that lasts nothing is passed. Past the end, the last step, gone to its end, and the practice is done.

<details><summary>The rule, in the code</summary>

```typescript
({ counts }) => (durations: readonly number[], seconds: number): { index: number; progress: number; done: boolean } => {
    let start = counts.zero
    for (const [index, length] of durations.entries()) {
      if (length > counts.zero && seconds < start + length) return { index, progress: Math.max(counts.zero, seconds - start) / length, done: false }
      start += length
    }
    return { index: Math.max(counts.zero, counts.previous(counts.count(durations))), progress: counts.one, done: true }
  }
```

</details>

- Owner: ghalaax
- Parameters: `counts` ← [Counts](../.trame/std/docs/algebra.md#Counts)
- Refines: [The breath sets the pace](product.md#BreathSetsThePace)
- Used by: [The moment of a practice](#MomentOf)

### How a movement eases

`BreathEasing` · `src/practice.ts:63`

A cubic, the same on both halves of the phase, that meet half way.

|---|---|
| half | 0.5 |
| power | 3 |

<a id="PlayPractice"></a>

### Play a practice

`PlayPractice` · `src/practice.ts:266` · status: **held**

Shows the player, then each moment as the screen's frames come, until the practice is done; says each movement aloud as it starts, in the app's language and in a few words (the breath, the words of the step, as the person chose), and, when a pose is held, what to do in it as the hold starts; strikes the bowl as the practice starts and ends, and, when the poses are held, as each movement starts; keeps the screen awake while it plays. The person pauses, resumes, starts again, turns the voice off or on, shows the landmarks or hides them, or goes back. On a device that cannot speak, the player says so and what to do to hear the voice, and offers no voice button.
